facts.text: Maria had a picnic with friends from church last weekend, where they played games and ate snacks.

evidence.quote: Yeah, last weekend I had a picnic with some friends from church. We chilled under the trees, played games, and ate yummy food. It was great!
What games did you all play?
Some fun ones like charades and a scavenger hunt. We all had a good laugh!

facts.text: Maria shared a photo of the picnic table with a drink, snacks, and a cell phone.

facts.text: John expressed appreciation for the military and the resilience of veterans, which inspired him to join.

evidence.quote: I heard some cool stories from an elderly veteran named Samuel. It was inspiring and heartbreaking, but seeing their resilience really filled me with hope. It reminded me why I wanted to join the military.
It's inspiring to see the resilience of the veterans in your group. Their stories are both inspiring and heartbreaking, but they fill us with hope.

facts.text: John mentioned planning to set up games for his children, inspired by the fun and laughter from the picnic and veteran stories.

evidence.quote: I'm thinking of setting up something like this for my kids soon.
